the nano-size Prussian blue film could be self- assembled on the Pt electrodes, and the electrochemical properties of the film were studied.
the self-assembled nano-size PB film with a controllable thickness can be fabricated on the Pt electrode by electrostatic layer- by-layer adsorption of the Fe(Ⅲ) and Fe(Ⅱ) hexacyanoferrat.
the nano-size Prussian blue film can be self-assembled onto the Pt electrodes with controlled thickness and the modified electrodes have good electrochemical properties.

the preparation of Prussian blue film on Pt electrodes with a controllable thickness and its electrochemical properties.
a novel method for the preparation of Prussian blue modified electrodes,which can be used as electrochemical biosensors.
the fabrication of a new type of electrochemical sensor by the electrostatic layer-by layer adsorption method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a series of Prussian modified Pt electrodes with different layers were prepared by self-assembly of iron(Ⅱ)and hexacyonoferrate(II)on Pt electrodes.The nano-size PB film was characterized by SEM and UV-vis spectroscopy.The electrochemical properties of the modified electrodes were studied by CV.The results showed that both the soluble and insoluble PB were the components of film,and the peak currents were in proportion to the scan rates and the concentration of the PB.
the self-assembled PB film on the Pt electrode has a good electrocatalytic effect for electrochemical analysis and has potential applications in electrochemical biosensors.
the Prussian blue film can be used as a model system in the study of electrostatic layer-by layer self-assembled films.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel and simple method to prepare PB modified electrodes with a controlled layer thickness and the electrodes could be used as biosensor.
a novel electrochemical biosensor was developed based on Prussian blue self-assembled film on Pt electrodes.
the nano-size Prussian blue film can be prepared by self-assembled technique and the film can be used as the electrode material of biosensor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nano-size Prussian blue film can be prepared on the Pt electrode by electrostatic adsorption, and the film has a good stability.
the nano-size film could be prepared by the electrostatic layer-bylayer adsorption,and the film thickness can be controlled by the dipping cycles.
it is possible to fabricate a PB modified Pt electrode using electrostatic layer-by layer adsorption of Fe(Ⅲ) and hexacyanofermate(Ⅱ).
